focus: External runtime configuration, installed hooks and home-level references
noveltyJustification: The repository manifests establish outbound global configuration boundaries and expose absolute-path dependencies that a repository-only move cannot update.
keyQuestions: Which references from outside the repository survive a git move?
Which runtime resolution assumptions remain unknown because upstream loaders are not vendored?
answeredQuestions: Codex hooks, Hermes MCP/trust/plugin state, Pi globals, OpenCode user fallbacks and machine-wide Git hooks are external surfaces.
The repository cannot verify every operator home directory or upstream runtime configurability.

ruledOut.approach: Treat every runtime configuration as repository-local
ruledOut.reason: The manifests explicitly place Codex hooks, Hermes configuration and OpenCode user fallbacks outside the repository.

keyFindings.finding: Codex, Hermes, Pi, OpenCode and global Git hooks have operator-level state outside the repository; old absolute paths can survive the source move.
Repository manifests establish project paths but do not prove upstream configurability or enumerate all external wrappers.
